title: [GMCP 203.031.06] Operations and evidence: Tool poisoning, prompt injection, rug-pull, and exfiltration defenses
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-031-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: All server descriptions, schemas, prompts, resources, UI and tool output are untrusted data. GMCP detects and contains hidden instructions, cross-server shadowing, schema/description rug pulls, Unicode deception, poisoned resources, indirect prompt injection and staged exfiltration; material metadata changes invalidate consent and trust; and a maintained adversarial corpus proves no content can authorize tools, reveal secrets or widen policy. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
